name: Novelty Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions that are most novel (dissimilar) with respect to existing reference conditions using pairwise distance metrics.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of novel samples to select from the condition pool.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Distance metric for measuring dissimilarity between conditions.

parameters.name: integration
parameters.description: Method for combining pairwise distances into overall dissimilarity score.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: Existing experimental conditions to compare against.
